# @AUTOGENERATED by scripts/gen_sol_mnt_compat.py - do not edit; run the generator.
# Restore vanilla gold-transfer scaling; M&T does not replace these effects.
REPLACE:change_gold_effect = {
	add_gold = {
		value = 1
		multiply = $scale$

		add = {
			value = capital_wealth
			multiply = $scale$
			multiply = 0.2
		}
		add = {
			value = country_economical_base
			multiply = $scale$
			multiply = 0.05
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				$scale$ >  0
			}
			min = {
				value = $scale$
			}
			max = {
				value = 5000
				multiply = $scale$
			}

		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				$scale$ < 0
			}
			max = {
				value = $scale$
			}
			min = {
				value = 5000
				multiply = $scale$
			}

		}
	}
}

REPLACE:change_estate_gold_effect = {

	add_gold_to_estate = {
		estate_type = $estate$
		value = {
			value = $scale$

			add = {
				value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax
				multiply = $scale$
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					$scale$ >  0
				}
				min = {
					value = $scale$
				}
				max = {	
					value = 5000
					multiply = $scale$
				}

			}
			
			if = {
				limit = {
					$scale$ < 0
				}
				max = {
					value = $scale$
				}
				min = {	
					value = 5000
					multiply = $scale$
				}

			}
		}
	}
}

REPLACE:sol_refresh_market_pop_demand_maps = {
	# Global scope. Refresh per-market unit spending and market-keyed goods counters.
	# Unit spending is hardcoded consumption quantity times min(market price, base price).
	# Also tracks which goods have suppressed demand (market_price > default_price).
	every_market_in_world = {
		save_scope_as = sol_market_cache
		set_local_variable = { name = sol_market_nobles_unit_spending value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sol_market_clergy_unit_spending value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sol_market_burghers_unit_spending value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sol_market_laborers_unit_spending value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sol_market_peasants_unit_spending value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sol_market_soldiers_unit_spending value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sol_market_tribesmen_unit_spending value = 0 }

		set_local_variable = { name = sol_market_actual_price_amber value = "market_price(goods:amber)" }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = sol_market_effective_price_amber
			value = {
				value = local_var:sol_market_actual_price_amber
				max = "default_price(goods:amber)"
			}
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = sol_market_consumes_amber_count value = "goods_supply_in_market(goods:amber)" }
		set_local_variable = { name = sol_market_price_suppressed_amber value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sol_market_actual_price_amber > "default_price(goods:amber)" }
			set_local_variable = { name = sol_market_price_suppressed_amber value = 1 }
		}
		remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_consumes_amber key = scope:sol_market_cache }
		add_to_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_consumes_amber key = scope:sol_market_cache value = local_var:sol_market_consumes_amber_count }
		remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_price_suppressed_amber key = scope:sol_market_cache }
		add_to_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_price_suppressed_amber key = scope:sol_market_cache value = local_var:sol_market_price_suppressed_amber }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sol_market_consumes_amber_count > 0 }
			change_local_variable = {
				name = sol_market_nobles_unit_spending
				add = {
					value = sol_unit_consumption_nobles_amber
					multiply = local_var:sol_market_effective_price_amber
				}
			}
			change_local_variable = {
				name = sol_market_burghers_unit_spending
				add = {
					value = sol_unit_consumption_burghers_amber
					multiply = local_var:sol_market_effective_price_amber
				}
			}
		}

		set_local_variable = { name = sol_market_actual_price_beer value = "market_price(goods:beer)" }

					value = sol_unit_consumption_nobles_beer
					multiply = local_var:sol_market_effective_price_beer
				}
			}

		remove_local_variable = sol_market_price_suppressed_livestock
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_lumber
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_actual_price_lumber
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_lumber_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_price_suppressed_lumber
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_maize
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_actual_price_maize
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_maize_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_price_suppressed_maize
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_marble
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_actual_price_marble
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_marble_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_price_suppressed_marble
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_masonry
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_actual_price_masonry
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_masonry_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_price_suppressed_masonry
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_medicaments
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_actual_price_medicaments
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_medicaments_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_price_suppressed_medicaments
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_mercury
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_actual_price_mercury
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_mercury_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_price_suppressed_mercury
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_millet
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_actual_price_millet
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_millet_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_price_suppressed_millet
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_olives
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_actual_price_olives
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_olives_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_price_suppressed_olives
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_paper
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_actual_price_paper
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_paper_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_price_suppressed_paper

	}
	set_global_variable = { name = sol_market_pop_demand_maps_initialized value = 1 }
}

# M&T calculation preserved byte-for-byte outside SOL_MNT marker sections.
REPLACE:epbm_calculate_maintenance = {
	set_local_variable = { name = epbm_total_cost value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = epbm_crown_total_cost value = 0 }
	# SOL_MNT_BEGIN location_cache_init
	save_temporary_scope_as = sol_mnt_maintenance_country
	if = {
		limit = { num_locations > 0 }
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { is_land = yes }
			set_variable = { name = sol_mnt_raw_shared_cost value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_mnt_raw_assigned_nobles value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_mnt_raw_assigned_clergy value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_mnt_raw_assigned_burghers value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_mnt_raw_assigned_peasants value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_mnt_raw_assigned_tribes value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_mnt_raw_assigned_dhimmi value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_mnt_raw_assigned_cossacks value = 0 }
		}
	}
	# SOL_MNT_END location_cache_init

	epbm_for_each_estate = { effect = epbm_init_estate_var }

	every_estate = {
		limit = { estate_type != estate_type:crown_estate }
		save_temporary_scope_as = epbm_cur_estate

		every_building_owned_by_estate = {
			save_temporary_scope_as = epbm_bldg
			building_type ?= { save_temporary_scope_as = epbm_bt }
			location ?= { market ?= { save_temporary_scope_as = epbm_mkt } }

			epbm_price_building = yes

			if = { limit = { local_var:epbm_bldg_cost > 0 } epbm_route_estate_building_cost = yes }
		}
	}

	every_owned_building = {
		limit = {
			is_opened = yes
			NOT = {
				building_type = { is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = epbm_blacklist target = this } }
			}
			NOT = { building_category = estate_category }
		}

		save_temporary_scope_as = epbm_bldg
		building_type ?= { save_temporary_scope_as = epbm_bt }
		location ?= { market ?= { save_temporary_scope_as = epbm_mkt } }

		epbm_price_building = yes

		if = { limit = { local_var:epbm_bldg_cost > 0 } epbm_route_building_cost = yes }
		# SOL_MNT_BEGIN shared_building_cache
		if = {
			limit = {
				local_var:epbm_bldg_cost > 0
				NOT = { building_category = government_category }
			}
			location = {
				if = {
					limit = { owner = scope:sol_mnt_maintenance_country }
					change_variable = { name = sol_mnt_raw_shared_cost add = local_var:epbm_bldg_cost }
				}
			}
		}
		# SOL_MNT_END shared_building_cache
	}

	every_owned_foreign_building = {
		limit = {
			is_opened = yes
			NOT = {
				building_type = { is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = epbm_blacklist target = this } }
			}
			NOT = { building_category = estate_category }
		}

		save_temporary_scope_as = epbm_bldg
		building_type ?= { save_temporary_scope_as = epbm_bt }
		location ?= { market ?= { save_temporary_scope_as = epbm_mkt } }

		epbm_price_building = yes

		if = { limit = { local_var:epbm_bldg_cost > 0 } epbm_route_building_cost = yes }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { local_var:epbm_total_cost > 0 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = epbm_shared_fraction
			value = {
				value = local_var:epbm_total_cost
				divide = { value = local_var:epbm_total_cost add = local_var:epbm_crown_total_cost }
			}
		}
	}
	else = { set_local_variable = { name = epbm_shared_fraction value = 0 } }

	epbm_for_each_estate = { effect = epbm_compute_modifier_scale }

	set_variable = { name = epbm_charge_factor value = { value = epbm_cost_share multiply = epbm_inflation_factor } }

	change_local_variable = { name = epbm_total_cost multiply = var:epbm_charge_factor }

	epbm_split_by_estate_power = yes
	epbm_add_estate_building_costs = yes
	# SOL_MNT_BEGIN location_cache_finalize
	set_local_variable = { name = sol_mnt_charge_factor value = var:epbm_charge_factor }
	set_local_variable = { name = sol_mnt_power_nobles value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sol_mnt_power_clergy value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sol_mnt_power_burghers value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sol_mnt_power_peasants value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sol_mnt_power_tribes value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sol_mnt_power_cossacks value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sol_mnt_include_tribes value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate } set_local_variable = { name = sol_mnt_power_nobles value = "estate_power(estate_type:nobles_estate)" } }
	if = { limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:clergy_estate } set_local_variable = { name = sol_mnt_power_clergy value = "estate_power(estate_type:clergy_estate)" } }
	if = { limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:burghers_estate } set_local_variable = { name = sol_mnt_power_burghers value = "estate_power(estate_type:burghers_estate)" } }
	if = { limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:peasants_estate } set_local_variable = { name = sol_mnt_power_peasants value = "estate_power(estate_type:peasants_estate)" } }
	if = { limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:cossacks_estate } set_local_variable = { name = sol_mnt_power_cossacks value = "estate_power(estate_type:cossacks_estate)" } }
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_has_estate = estate_type:tribes_estate
			NOT = {
				OR = {
					has_estate_privilege = estate_privilege:tribes_scotland_gaelic_heritage
					has_estate_privilege = estate_privilege:autonomous_tribes_scotland_gaelic_heritage
				}
			}
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = sol_mnt_include_tribes value = 1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sol_mnt_power_tribes value = "estate_power(estate_type:tribes_estate)" }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { num_locations > 0 }
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { is_land = yes }
			set_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_nobles value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_nobles add = { value = var:sol_mnt_raw_assigned_nobles multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_charge_factor } }
			change_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_nobles add = { value = var:sol_mnt_raw_shared_cost multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_power_nobles multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_charge_factor } }

			set_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_clergy value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_clergy add = { value = var:sol_mnt_raw_assigned_clergy multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_charge_factor } }
			change_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_clergy add = { value = var:sol_mnt_raw_shared_cost multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_power_clergy multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_charge_factor } }

			set_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_burghers value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_burghers add = { value = var:sol_mnt_raw_assigned_burghers multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_charge_factor } }
			change_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_burghers add = { value = var:sol_mnt_raw_shared_cost multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_power_burghers multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_charge_factor } }

			set_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_commoners value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_commoners add = { value = var:sol_mnt_raw_assigned_peasants multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_charge_factor } }
			change_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_commoners add = { value = var:sol_mnt_raw_shared_cost multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_power_peasants multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_charge_factor } }

			set_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_tribesmen value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_tribesmen add = { value = var:sol_mnt_raw_assigned_cossacks multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_charge_factor } }
			change_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_tribesmen add = { value = var:sol_mnt_raw_shared_cost multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_power_cossacks multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_charge_factor } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:sol_mnt_include_tribes > 0 }
				change_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_tribesmen add = { value = var:sol_mnt_raw_assigned_tribes multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_charge_factor } }
				change_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_tribesmen add = { value = var:sol_mnt_raw_shared_cost multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_power_tribes multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_charge_factor } }
			}
		}
	}
	# SOL_MNT_END location_cache_finalize

	set_variable = {
		name = epbm_crown_pool_cost
		value = { value = local_var:epbm_total_cost multiply = "estate_power(estate_type:crown_estate)" }
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = epbm_crown_bldg_cost
		value = { value = local_var:epbm_crown_total_cost multiply = var:epbm_charge_factor }
	}
	# SOL_MNT_BEGIN local_variable_cleanup
	epbm_for_each_estate = { effect = sol_mnt_cleanup_epbm_estate_local_variable }
	remove_local_variable = epbm_total_cost
	remove_local_variable = epbm_crown_total_cost
	remove_local_variable = epbm_shared_fraction
	remove_local_variable = epbm_bldg_cost
	remove_local_variable = sol_mnt_charge_factor
	remove_local_variable = sol_mnt_power_nobles
	remove_local_variable = sol_mnt_power_clergy
	remove_local_variable = sol_mnt_power_burghers
	remove_local_variable = sol_mnt_power_peasants
	remove_local_variable = sol_mnt_power_tribes
	remove_local_variable = sol_mnt_power_cossacks
	remove_local_variable = sol_mnt_include_tribes
	# SOL_MNT_END local_variable_cleanup

}

# Clear helper-local calculations while retaining epbm_bldg_cost for the parent pass.
REPLACE:epbm_price_building = {
	set_local_variable = { name = epbm_bldg_cost value = 0 }

	random_production_method_of_building = {
		limit = {
			any_required_goods = { count >= 1 }
			NOT = { exists = produced_goods }
			is_available_for = scope:epbm_bldg.owner
			is_allowed_for = scope:epbm_bldg.owner
			is_visible_for = scope:epbm_bldg.owner
		}

		save_temporary_scope_as = epbm_pm

		prev = {
			set_local_variable = { name = epbm_per_level value = 0 }

			# Check cache on market center
			scope:epbm_mkt = {
				location = {
					if = {
						limit = { has_variable_map = epbm_pm_cache is_key_in_variable_map = { name = epbm_pm_cache target = scope:epbm_pm } }
						set_local_variable = { name = epbm_per_level value = "variable_map(epbm_pm_cache|scope:epbm_pm)" }
					}
				}
			}

			# Cache miss: compute from building_goods_input
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:epbm_per_level <= 0 }

				scope:epbm_pm = {
					every_required_goods = {
						save_temporary_scope_as = epbm_cur_good
						set_local_variable = { name = epbm_price value = "price_in_market(scope:epbm_mkt)" }
						scope:epbm_bldg = { set_local_variable = { name = epbm_qty value = "building_goods_input(scope:epbm_cur_good)" } }
						change_local_variable = { name = epbm_bldg_cost add = { value = local_var:epbm_price multiply = local_var:epbm_qty } }
					}
				}

				# building_goods_input returns market_access * efficiency scaled values;
				# divide both out to recover the base per-level cost for caching
				set_local_variable = { name = epbm_loc_access value = "location.market_access" }
				set_local_variable = { name = epbm_bldg_eff value = "location.building_efficiency(scope:epbm_bt)" }

				if = {
					limit = { local_var:epbm_loc_access > 0 }
					change_local_variable = { name = epbm_bldg_cost divide = local_var:epbm_loc_access }
				}

				if = {
					limit = { local_var:epbm_bldg_eff > 0 }
					change_local_variable = { name = epbm_bldg_cost divide = local_var:epbm_bldg_eff }
				}

				set_local_variable = { name = epbm_per_level value = { value = local_var:epbm_bldg_cost divide = building_level } }

				# Cache the per-level base cost
				scope:epbm_mkt = {
					location = {
						add_to_variable_map = {
							name = epbm_pm_cache
							key = scope:epbm_pm
							value = local_var:epbm_per_level
						}
						add_to_variable_map = {
							name = epbm_bt_costs
							key = scope:epbm_bt
							value = local_var:epbm_per_level
						}

						# variable maps don't overwrite; must remove before re-adding
						if = {
							limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = epbm_bt_display target = scope:epbm_bt } }
							remove_from_variable_map = { name = epbm_bt_display key = scope:epbm_bt }
						}

						add_to_variable_map = {
							name = epbm_bt_display
							key = scope:epbm_bt
							value = local_var:epbm_per_level
						}
					}
				}
			}

			# Apply level and efficiency to get actual cost
			set_local_variable = { name = epbm_bldg_eff value = "location.building_efficiency(scope:epbm_bt)" }
			set_local_variable = {
				name = epbm_bldg_cost
				value = {
					value = local_var:epbm_per_level
					multiply = building_level
					multiply = local_var:epbm_bldg_eff
				}
			}
		}
	}

	remove_local_variable = epbm_per_level
	remove_local_variable = epbm_price
	remove_local_variable = epbm_qty
	remove_local_variable = epbm_loc_access
	remove_local_variable = epbm_bldg_eff
}

REPLACE:epbm_set_pay_from_power = {
	set_local_variable = { name = est value = estate_type:$estate$_estate }

	if = {
		limit = { country_has_estate = local_var:est }

		set_variable = {
			name = epbm_pay_$estate$
			value = { value = local_var:epbm_total_cost multiply = "estate_power(local_var:est)" }
		}
		set_variable = { name = epbm_pool_$estate$ value = var:epbm_pay_$estate$ }
	}

	remove_local_variable = est
}

REPLACE:epbm_compute_modifier_scale = {
	set_local_variable = { name = est value = estate_type:$estate$_estate }

	if = {
		limit = { country_has_estate = local_var:est }
		set_variable = {
			name = epbm_mod_$estate$
			value = {
				value = "estate_power(local_var:est)"
				multiply = local_var:epbm_shared_fraction
				multiply = epbm_cost_share
				multiply = epbm_inflation_factor
			}
		}
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = epbm_mod_$estate$ value = 0 } }

	remove_local_variable = est
}

sol_mnt_cleanup_epbm_estate_local_variable = {
	remove_local_variable = epbm_estate_$estate$
}

# Reuse M&T's existing seven-estate dispatch instead of running a second pass.
REPLACE:epbm_route_to_cur_estate = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:epbm_cur_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:$estate$_estate } }
		change_local_variable = { name = epbm_estate_$estate$ add = local_var:epbm_bldg_cost }
		# SOL_MNT_BEGIN assigned_location_cache
		if = {
			limit = { location = { owner = scope:sol_mnt_maintenance_country } }
			location = {
				change_variable = { name = sol_mnt_raw_assigned_$estate$ add = local_var:epbm_bldg_cost }
			}
		}
		# SOL_MNT_END assigned_location_cache
	}
}
